null: artifact must be an object with version, producer, command_argv, code_snapshot, environment, run, and proof_results
array: artifact must be an object with version, producer, command_argv, code_snapshot, environment, run, and proof_results
empty: artifact.version must be kibi.proof-run.v1; received null
artifact.command_argv must be a non-empty array of the exact executed command arguments
artifact.code_snapshot must be the 64-hex workspace snapshot captured before the run
artifact.environment must be a typed environment object
artifact.run must be an object with outcome, exit_code, started_at, and finished_at
artifact.proof_results must be a non-empty array of proof results with symbol_id, target, outcome, binding, and attempts
producerString: artifact.producer must be an object with a non-empty name (and optional version)
producerBlank: artifact.producer.name must be a non-empty string
producerBadVersion: artifact.producer.version must be a non-empty string when present
executorBad: artifact.executor.name must be a non-empty string
artifact.executor.version must be a non-empty string when present
executorNull: artifact.executor must be an object with a non-empty name (and optional version)
argvString: artifact.command_argv must be a non-empty array of the exact executed command arguments
argvEmpty: artifact.command_argv must be a non-empty array of the exact executed command arguments
argvBlank: artifact.command_argv must be a non-empty array of the exact executed command arguments
snapshotUpper: artifact.code_snapshot must be the 64-hex workspace snapshot captured before the run
snapshotLong: artifact.code_snapshot must be the 64-hex workspace snapshot captured before the run
snapshotPrefixed: artifact.code_snapshot must be the 64-hex workspace snapshot captured before the run
snapshotNumber: artifact.code_snapshot must be the 64-hex workspace snapshot captured before the run
snapshotObject: artifact.code_snapshot must be the 64-hex workspace snapshot captured before the run

environmentArray: artifact.environment must be a typed environment object

environmentFunction: artifact.environment must contain only JSON values
runString: artifact.run must be an object with outcome, exit_code, started_at, and finished_at
runEmpty: artifact.run.outcome must be one of: passed, failed, errored, cancelled, timed_out, interrupted, no_results; received null
artifact.run.exit_code must be an integer; received null
artifact.run.started_at must be a non-empty ISO timestamp
artifact.run.finished_at must be a non-empty ISO timestamp
runBad: artifact.run.outcome must be one of: passed, failed, errored, cancelled, timed_out, interrupted, no_results; received "great"
artifact.run.exit_code must be an integer; received 1.5
artifact.run.started_at must be a non-empty ISO timestamp
artifact.run.finished_at must be a non-empty ISO timestamp
artifact.run.failure_phase must be one of: setup, collection, execution, teardown, infrastructure; received "lunch"
runNullPhase: artifact.run.failure_phase must be one of: setup, collection, execution, teardown, infrastructure; received null
resultsString: artifact.proof_results must be a non-empty array of proof results with symbol_id, target, outcome, binding, and attempts
resultsEmpty: artifact.proof_results must be a non-empty array of proof results with symbol_id, target, outcome, binding, and attempts
